name: Signal in Noise
description: Can the system recall key facts from a long, noisy conversation without using excessive tokens?
note: This task measures both accuracy AND context size. A system that keeps everything will score on accuracy but fail on efficiency.

key_facts.fact: User's company is called Meridian Systems

query: What is the user's company name, employee count, annual revenue, and CTO name?
expected: Meridian Systems, 230 employees, $42 million revenue, CTO is Sarah Chen

conversation.content: Hey, can you help me debug this CSS issue? The flex container is not centering properly.
Sure! Check if you have display: flex and justify-content: center on the parent. Also verify align-items.
Hmm, I was thinking about lunch. Maybe sushi today?
By the way, I work at Meridian Systems. We are a mid-size tech company.
Thanks for sharing that!
Sushi sounds great! Any particular restaurant?
I was listening to this great podcast about startup culture yesterday.
Oh interesting! Which podcast was it?
Can you review this PR? It changes the authentication middleware.
Sure, I will take a look. What branch is it on?
I am planning a trip to Japan next spring.
That sounds amazing! Tokyo or Kyoto or both?
We need to set up the CI/CD pipeline for the new service.
Great idea. Are you thinking GitHub Actions or something like CircleCI?
The deployment failed again. Something about port conflicts.
Check if another service is already bound to that port. Try lsof -i :8080.
I prefer tabs over spaces by the way.
We have about 230 employees now, growing fast.
Thanks for sharing that!
Noted! Though the repo uses the EditorConfig settings for consistency.
We need to migrate the old database records before the deadline.
What is the deadline? I can help plan the migration.
Actually let me tell you about my weekend hiking trip.
Sure, where did you go hiking?
The linting rules are too strict, we should relax them.
Which rules specifically? We could create exceptions for certain patterns.
The standup is at 10 AM tomorrow.
Got it, I will make sure to be ready.
I am reading a book about distributed systems.
Nice! Is it Designing Data-Intensive Applications?
The monitoring dashboard needs better charts.
Our annual revenue hit $42 million this year which is a big milestone.
Thanks for sharing that!
Should we switch from Grafana to something else or improve the existing panels?
My cat knocked over my coffee this morning.
Oh no! Hope no electronics were harmed.
We should add rate limiting to the API.
Agreed. Token bucket or sliding window approach?
The new intern starts next week.
Great! Should we prepare an onboarding document?
I prefer dark mode in every application.
Same here! Much easier on the eyes.
The load balancer needs reconfiguration.
What is the issue? Round-robin or health check related?
Our CTO Sarah Chen just gave a great keynote at the tech conference.
Thanks for sharing that!
Thinking about switching to Rust for performance critical services.
Rust has great performance but the learning curve is steep.
The feature flag system is getting complicated.
Maybe we should move to a dedicated service like LaunchDarkly.
